_comment: Request for the device-evidence workflow (CLAUDE.md evidence source 1).
workflow_dispatch only reaches workflows present on the repository's
default branch, and this session's GitHub proxy refuses repository
settings writes, so the default branch cannot be moved to the working
branch. The workflow is therefore triggered by pushing a change to this
file, which also puts every run's parameters under version control.
Bump 'nonce' and push to request another run; set 'enabled' false to
stop the workflow from running on unrelated pushes to its own sources.
